content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD sponge-layer and breakwater-absorber module (BSD header L1-44, FILE sponge.F L3). Six subroutines. (1) SPONGE_DAMPING (L52-66, Larsen-Dancy 1983 type per L46): each step divides ETA (only where MASK>ZERO, L58-60) and U,V (unconditionally, L61-62) by SPONGE(I,J). (2) ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC (L77-127): builds target incident fields Ein2D/Uin2D/Vin2D as Fourier sums over NumFreq of Cm_*/Sm_* with COS/SIN(pi/2+Segma_Ser*TIME+Phase_Ser) (L94-108), attenuates targets by /SPONGE**4 (L110-116), then relaxes model fields toward targets: Eta=Ein2D+(Eta-Ein2D)/SpongeMaker (L119-125). (3) CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER (L136-184): west-side-only Larsen-Dancy coefficient Sponge=MAX(A_Sponge**ri,lim) with ri=R_sponge**(50*(I-1)/(Iwidth-1)) (L178, parallel offset variant L175), Iwidth=INT(Sponge_west_width/DX)+Nghost (L161), lim keeps existing SPONGE>1 (L167-171). (4) CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE (L194-366): friction-type sponge CD field (output SPONGE, comment L224-225 says it holds CD): per side tmp=MAX(CDsponge*TANH(ri/10.0),lim) with ri=MAX(0,Iwidth-distance) ramps (west L241-262, east L266-286, merged by max L288-296; south L300-324, north L329-353, merged L355-363); parallel index offsets use iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend (L253, L278, L316, L345, ykchoi Jan/23/2018 replacing npx*Mglob/px forms). (5) CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L376-551): identical structure but coefficient Csp (nu_sponge target; L440, L469, L507, L536). (6) CALCULATE_SPONGE (L562-738): classic Larsen-Dancy division sponge for all four sides, tmp=MAX(A_Sponge**ri,lim) with ri=R_sponge**(50*d/(Iwidth-1)) (west L624/L621, east L652/L649, south L691/L688, north L720/L717), lim floor 1.0 (L613-617 etc.), merge by max plus floor clamp IF(Sponge<A_Sponge**(R_Sponge**50))Sponge=1.0_SP (L666, L734). (7) CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (L749-906, 04/27/2017): master rank builds global absorber tmp_glob on (Mglob+2*Nghost)x(Nglob+2*Nghost) (L778, L796-819): for every cell with BreakWaterWidth>0, spreads tmp_2d=BreakWaterAbsorbCoef*TANH((BreakWaterWidth-ri)/(0.3_SP*BreakWaterWidth)) (L806-807) over the radius-BreakWaterWidth disk (L801-816, max-combined L812); then distributes to per-rank CD_breakwater: ykchoi (28/Jan/2018) scheme gathers each rank's iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend (L847-862), master copies its own slice tmp_glob(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) (L864-866) and sends ghost-extended subarrays via mpi_isend/mpi_wait to each rank which mpi_irecv's into CD_breakwater (L868-895); serial branch CD_breakwater=tmp_glob (L901); old MPI_Gather/MPI_Scatter code commented (L829-845). No file I/O. Data blocks: none.

verbatim_spans.text: !    SPONGE_DAMPING is subroutine for dampping waves using Larsen-Dancy(1983)
! note that I used SPONGE represent CD from input, do not mess up
! with the sponge defined in the direction sponge

unresolved: SPONGE_DAMPING guards only ETA with MASK>ZERO (L58-60) while U,V are damped even at masked cells (L61-62); MASK (integer) is compared against real ZERO.

ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC: Din2D (L85) and K (L84) declared but unused; Grav and Stokes_Drift_Ser imported (L79-81) but unused; the /SPONGE**4 attenuation of targets (L112-114) has no in-file justification; loop indices i,j are module variables imported from GLOBAL (L78).

CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER handles only a west-side sponge (signature carries only Sponge_west_width, L136-138) unlike the four-sided CALCULATE_SPONGE; its serial/parallel ri difference is only the iista offset (L175 vs L178).
50*(I-1)/(Iwidth-1) (L178, L621-624, L688-691, L717-720) is integer division, so the Larsen-Dancy exponent ri changes in integer steps; Iwidth=1 would divide by zero (no guard).

CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE west/east passes reset lim=0.0_SP unconditionally (L249, L274), discarding any pre-existing SPONGE, while south/north use lim=SPONGE(I,J) if positive (L308-312, L337-341); also SPONGE is INTENT(OUT) and zeroed (L217, L235) whereas CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE takes INTENT(INOUT) (L399) and never zeroes -- asymmetries not explained.

R_sponge and A_sponge dummies are unused in CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE and CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE (amplitudes come from GLOBAL CDsponge L199 / Csp L381); depth and MinDepthFrc are imported in all three calculators (L199, L381, L568) but never used; DXg,DYg,xx (L220, L402, L589) assigned/declared but unused.

CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER: tmp_glob spans Mglob+2*Nghost x Nglob+2*Nghost (L778, L797-798) but the spreading loops clamp Ib,Jb to Min(Mglob,...)/Min(Nglob,...) and MAX(1,...) (L802-803), so upper ghost rows/cols beyond Mglob/Nglob never receive absorber values while lower ghost cells (1..Nghost) can; relation L797-798 vs L802-803.
CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER master slice CD_breakwater=tmp_glob(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) (L865) assumes rank 0's subdomain starts at global index 1; correctness depends on iista/jjsta convention defined elsewhere.

The distribution loop (L868-895) serializes one mpi_isend+mpi_wait per rank from master; ireq/istatus reused; ri,lim (L773) and Iwidth partially unused in the breakwater routine (Iwidth,Jwidth used only as disk radii L800-801).
MPI symbols (mpi_status_size L768, MPI_INTEGER L855, mpi_sp L881, MPI_COMM_WORLD) are not use-associated in this file; presumably via PARAM or an MPI module elsewhere.
